body:
# Filemark — Roadmap

Living plan for where filemark grows after v0.1. Scope framing: **personal**
power-tool for one developer (the author). Sharing / collaboration / enterprise
features stay out of scope until the personal UX is excellent.

Source-of-truth lives in the private-repo (`docsi/ROADMAP.md`), symlinked into
`filemark/` via repolink. Update here, not there.

- **Date opened:** 2026-04-23
- **Owner:** personal
- **Guiding principle:** every feature must make *reading / navigating / extracting
  insight from markdown files* better. Passive-reader first, lightweight-interactive
  second, editor last.

---

## 1. Thematic pillars

Filemark isn't just a markdown renderer — it's a **programmable reading surface**.
Each pillar is a family of features that all share the same interaction model:
author writes markdown, filemark upgrades parts of it into something interactive.

| Pillar | What it does | Shipped? |
|---|---|---|
| **1. Data** | CSV → datagrid, JSON tree, schema diagrams, charts from data | Datagrid v1 ✓ · Chart v1 ✓ · Stats v1 ✓ |
| **2. Form / capture** | ```form blocks, stepper, quiz, poll, survey — all local-storage-backed | — |
| **3. Tasks & organization** | cross-file task list, kanban from tables, timeline/gantt from dates | Task-checkbox persistence ✓ · Kanban v1 ✓ |
| **4. Writing / reading UX** | presentation mode, outline, reading progress, density | TOC ✓ · ADR block ✓ |
| **5. Knowledge graph** | backlinks, tag index, file-to-file linking, graph view | — |
| **6. Embeds & media** | gallery from a folder, video / iframe / Excalidraw, live reload | `<SmartImage>` ✓ |
| **7. Tools & meta** | command palette, diff, search, AI chat w/ doc context | Full-text search ✓ |

Everything below is tagged by pillar.

---

## 2. Datagrid evolution (pillar 1 — data)

Shipped in M7: core sort / filter / resize / virtualize, 18 rich column types,
`<Datagrid>` tag + ` ```csv ` fence, `src=` relative & absolute URL loading,
StorageAdapter persistence, JSON + MD export, 12-col example.

### 2.1 Datagrid v1.1 — quick wins ✅ **shipped 2026-04-23**

All landed. See `DATAGRID.md` §11a–11g for implementation detail,
`examples/datagrid-full.md` §23–29 for live exhibits.

- [x] **Multi-column sort** — click replaces, shift-click adds a
  secondary. Initial multi-sort via `sort=a:asc,b:desc`. Active
  ordinals `1,2,3…` rendered next to sort arrows.
- [x] **Row selection column** — `selection` info-string flag enables
  a pinned checkbox column. Header checkbox toggles all filtered rows
  (indeterminate when partial).
- [x] **Bulk copy** — when rows are selected, toolbar shows **Copy
  CSV / Copy MD / Copy JSON**; projects through visible columns,
  writes to `navigator.clipboard`.
- [x] **Keyboard nav** — arrows, home/end, ctrl+home/end for first /
  last row, pgup/pgdn (±10 rows), `/` focuses search, space toggles
  selection on focused row. Focus ring + auto-scroll-to-focused-row.
- [x] **Pinned columns** — `freeze=<col>,<col>,…` pins listed user
  columns to the left (cumulative `position: sticky` offsets). `_select`
  and `_rowno` are always pinned.
- [x] **Match highlight** — filter / search terms wrap in `<mark>`
  inside plain-text / markdown cells. Structured cells ignore.
- [x] **Density toggle** — compact / comfy / relaxed presets; toolbar
  button cycles. Persisted via `StorageAdapter`. Seed via
  `density=compact`.
- [x] **Aggregation footer** — `agg:<col>=sum|avg|min|max|count|uniq`.
  Sticky bottom row; recomputes on filter change; formatting honors
  column type.

### 2.2 Datagrid v1.2 — structural ✅ **shipped 2026-04-23**

All landed. See `DATAGRID.md` §11h–11k for implementation detail,
`examples/datagrid-full.md` §30–33 for live exhibits.

- [x] **Row grouping** — `group-by=<col>` with collapsible group
  headers; aggregation functions render inside group headers when
  `agg:<col>=…` is also set.
- [x] **Typed filter UIs** — numeric min/max, date-range pickers,
  multi-select chips for `status` / `tags`, tri-state button for
  booleans; fallback is the existing text filter.
- [x] **Row expansion / detail panel** — `expandable` flag prepends a
  chevron column; click → two-column definition-list panel below the
  row renders every visible column via `CellRenderer`.
- [x] **URL-state sync** — `url-sync` mirrors state into
  `location.hash#g=…` (base64-JSON), preserves heading anchors, URL
  wins over StorageAdapter on hydration so shared links reproduce.

### 2.3 Datagrid v2 — rich types batch ✅ **first wave shipped 2026-04-23**

Shipped: `sparkline` (line/bar/area), `icon` (15-icon set), `country`
(ISO2 → flag), `duration` (s/ms/m/h input units), `range` (date /
numeric auto-detect), `code-block` (multi-line monospace), `json`
(inline pretty-print), `image` (absolute URLs as thumbnails). See
`examples/datagrid-full.md` §34.

Still queued for v2.1:

- `image` — relative paths via AssetResolver (threading needed) +
  click-to-lightbox.
- `markdown-block` — full markdown in a cell (needs `react-markdown`
  inside `@filemark/datagrid` or a lightweight block parser).
- `reference` — `@other.csv:id-42` → inline row preview from another
  grid.
- `geopoint` — lat,lng → map pin / coords.

### 2.4 Datagrid v2 — data I/O (medium)

- **Streaming parse** — Papaparse worker for >1 MB files; rows appear progressively.
- **Export expansion** — `.xlsx`, TSV, HTML table (currently JSON + MD).
- **Saved views** — named snapshots of sort+filter+hidden+sizing; switch from dropdown.
- **Live reload** — hook into auto-refresh so `src=` re-fetches on change.

### 2.5 Datagrid v3 — analytics (high value, heavy)

- **Chart toggle** — grid ↔ chart (bar / line / scatter / pie). Axes inferred
  from column types.
- **Column stats popover** — click header → histogram / min/max/mean/median /
  unique / null counts.
- **Pivot preview** — rows/cols/values drag targets; live result.
- **Auto-type suggestions** — on first render, propose type hints banner:
  *"`revenue` looks like USD — apply `type:revenue=currency(USD)`?"*

### 2.6 Datagrid v3 — a11y / perf (required for public release)

- Proper `role="grid"` + `aria-rowindex` / `aria-sort` / `aria-colcount`.
- Screen-reader announcements on sort / filter / navigate.
- Horizontal column virtualization for 50+ col CSVs.

### 2.7 Follow-up already queued

- **M7b — Remote CSV permission UX** (Option B): `optional_host_permissions`
  + in-UI Grant button. Scope captured in `TASKS.md` and `DATAGRID.md`.

---

## 3. Form / capture (pillar 2)

Markdown-as-programmable-form. All state lives in the StorageAdapter — no
server, no submit-anywhere, no PII leaves the machine.

### 3.1 ```form block — MVP (~1 week)

Authoring:

````md
```form id=onboarding
- name: string "What's your name?"
- email: email "Email"
- role: select[eng, design, pm, other] "Role"
- comfortable: rating "How comfortable w/ TypeScript?" max=5
- notes: textarea "Anything else?"
- submit
```
````

Render: real inputs, labels, submit button. On submit → write the whole form
state to `filemark:form:<fileId>:<formId>` + show a success card. Pre-fill
from saved state on mount.

Field types: `string`, `email`, `url`, `phone`, `number`, `date`, `textarea`,
`checkbox`, `radio[a, b, c]`, `select[a, b, c]`, `multiselect[a, b, c]`,
`rating`, `slider[0..100]`, `file` (local only, stored as blob handle).

### 3.2 Stepper / wizard (follow-up)

```md
<Step title="Install">
  ...markdown...
</Step>
<Step title="Configure">
  ...
</Step>
<Step title="Verify">
  <!-- inline form fields allowed -->
</Step>
```

Navigation between steps, progress bar, per-step persistence, branching
(`next-if="role == 'eng'"`).

### 3.3 Quiz / flashcard

Reuse form fields + add a correctness check. Score at the end, retry wrong
answers.

### 3.4 Poll / survey (local)

Aggregates responses over time if the same .md is re-opened. Useful for
daily journaling prompts or tracking mood / habit streaks.

---

## 4. Tasks & organization (pillar 3)

### 4.1 Cross-file task dashboard

Walk every opened .md, collect `- [ ] / - [x]` items, show in one sidebar
view. Filter by file / tag / status. Uses existing `TaskCheckbox` persistence.

### 4.2 Kanban from a datagrid

`<Kanban src="./tasks.csv" group-by="status" />` — reuse datagrid's data
layer, render columns + cards. Drag a card → update the grouped column's
value → persist via StorageAdapter (not the CSV file — this is a reader).

### 4.3 Timeline / Gantt

`<Timeline src="./roadmap.csv" start="start" end="end" label="title" />` —
horizontal bars on a date axis. Zoom + pan. Reuses datagrid's date type
inference.

### 4.4 Calendar view

Same data model, calendar render. Month / week / day.

---

## 5. Writing / reading UX (pillar 4)

### 5.1 Presentation mode

Any `.md` → slide deck using H2s as slide breaks. Full-screen, keyboard nav,
speaker notes from `<!-- notes: … -->`. Export to standalone HTML.

### 5.2 Outline / mind map

Current TOC is flat. Outline view = collapsible tree. Mind map = radial graph
layout from the outline.

### 5.3 Reading progress

Scroll position per file persists. Top bar shows "42% read". Optional
time-on-page tracking (local).

### 5.4 Density controls

Font, line-height, max-width, theme variant. Already partially there;
unify into a single "reading prefs" dialog.

### 5.5 Split view / side-by-side

Two docs side by side (diff, comparison, editing alongside reference).

---

## 6. Knowledge graph (pillar 5)

### 6.1 Backlinks panel

For the current file, list every other file that links to it. Requires an
index pass across the folder on open.

### 6.2 Tag index

`#tag` inline or frontmatter `tags: [a, b]` → sidebar tag cloud + per-tag
file list.

### 6.3 Graph view

Obsidian-style node graph. Nodes = files, edges = links + tag co-occurrence.
Click a node → open file.

### 6.4 Quick jump

`⌘K` command palette: fuzzy file / heading / tag search → open.

---

## 7. Embeds & media (pillar 6)

### 7.1 Gallery view

Folder of images rendered as grid; click → lightbox. Reuses AssetResolver.

### 7.2 Video / iframe safe-embed

`<Video src="https://…" />` → privacy-friendly YouTube / Vimeo embed.
`<Embed src="https://excalidraw.com/…" />` for Excalidraw / Loom / Figma
with the right CSP.

### 7.3 Diagram authoring

Mermaid already works. Add:
- Inline Excalidraw (load & edit locally)
- ASCII-art auto-upgrade (`remark-flowchart` for `graph TD` style blocks
  outside mermaid)

---

## 8. Tools & meta (pillar 7)

### 8.1 Command palette (⌘K)

Actions: open file, toggle sidebar, switch theme, re-sync folder, jump to
heading, search in file, search across files, open options.

### 8.2 Diff two .md files

Git-style diff view; preserves rich rendering (markdown-aware diff, not
plain-text diff).

### 8.3 AI chat with current doc context

Side panel, local key from options page. Claude API. Pre-seeded system
prompt with the current doc (or selected portion). Saves conversation
history per doc. Opt-in, off by default.

### 8.4 Lint / writing stats

Word count, reading time, readability, link checker, dead link highlighter.

---

## 9. Sequencing — what to build when

Ordering based on (1) completeness of adjacent work, (2) effort, (3) user joy.

### Now — small wins on top of shipped datagrid

1. ✅ **Datagrid v1.1 quick wins** (§2.1) — shipped 2026-04-23.
2. **Task dashboard** (§4.1) — reuses the existing TaskCheckbox persistence.
   Half a day.

### Next — first new pillar

3. **```form MVP** (§3.1) — opens the whole "pillar 2" family. Foundation
   for stepper / quiz / poll.
4. **Command palette ⌘K** (§8.1) — touches every other feature (jump-to,
   toggle-pref, search). Worth doing before piling more features on.

### Then — structural datagrid + knowledge

5. ✅ **Datagrid v1.2** (§2.2) — shipped 2026-04-23.
6. **Backlinks + tag index** (§6.1 + §6.2) — together because they share
   the folder index pass.

### Later — the big, splashy ones

7. Presentation mode (§5.1).
8. Kanban / Timeline built on the datagrid data layer (§4.2, §4.3).
9. Graph view (§6.3).
10. AI chat (§8.3).
11. Chart mode (§2.5).

### Someday / if needed

- Edit mode (Monaco / CodeMirror). Sandbox-iframe MDX. Pivot tables.
  Google Sheets import. Excalidraw embed. Kanban drag.

---

## 10. Non-goals (explicit)

Keep these out of scope so the plan doesn't drift:

- **Cloud sync / multi-device.** Local-first by design.
- **Collaboration / real-time editing.** Solo tool.
- **Publishing / static-site export.** (Arguably a stretch goal; not
  near-term.)
- **Server-side anything.** The app is entirely client-side.
- **Plugin system for third-party extensions.** Maybe v3; premature for now.

---

## 11. How to update this doc

- Add new entries under the appropriate pillar.
- When something ships, move the line to the "Shipped" column in §1 and
  delete the detail from §2–§8.
- When a tier's scope gets too fluffy, split it and move to `TASKS.md`
  as actionable work items.
- Prune anything that hasn't moved in 3 months — it's probably not
  actually wanted.

---

## 12. Related docs

- `TASKS.md` — current concrete work items (milestone-tracked).
- `ARCHITECTURE.md` — system design; each major feature should update the
  matching section when landed.
- `DATAGRID.md` — technical ref for the datagrid pillar.
- `PLANNING_COMPONENTS.md` — brainstorm of rich components for planning /
  spec / brainstorm docs (Chart, Kanban, Timeline, ADR, 2×2 matrix, …).
  Feeds pillar 1 (data) and pillar 4 (reading UX).
- `PROBLEM.md` — the original problem statement; new pillars should trace
  back to a pain point listed there (or explicitly add one).
